_about: The birthday prototypes (proto-party, 2 Nov 2026; js/party-proto/): the words and lines the five party games need that the family has not recorded yet (build/reports/designs/party-guests.md §1 'Mum's sheet for the party', party-gifts.md §1). Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.

nm-zara.src: the birthday girl: a placeholder name (Zafar, 1 Nov: the placeholder names are fine)

ph-mum.src: mum as a kin word with an owner (Zara's mum); the engine has Ma only as the cast's name

ph-aunt.src: mother's sister (masi): Mum records the kin word (party-guests.md open question 4)

how-guide.e: Go round and ask everyone how they are.

statues-guide.e: When the clapping stops, do what I say!

gift-guide.e: Open the boxes and give out the presents.
